title: the Free Port Rising Anew
author: Astrid Okafor
blurb: Ivo Yarrow, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
